 137    class SortingFunctions:
 138
 139        """
 140        Functions to sort cardlists.
 141        Each cardlist is: [(RenderableCard (Class), amount)]
 142        """
 143
 144        @staticmethod
 145        def no_order(cardlist):
 146            return cardlist
 147
 148        @staticmethod
 149        def randomized(cardlist):
 150            cardlist_copy = cardlist.copy()
 151            random.shuffle(cardlist_copy)
 152            return cardlist_copy
 153
 154        @staticmethod
 155        def name_descending(cardlist):
 156
 157            clist = cardlist.copy()
 158            clist.sort(key=lambda x: x[0].info().name)
 159            return clist
 160
 161        @staticmethod
 162        def name_ascending(cardlist):
 163
 164            clist = cardlist.copy()
 165            clist.sort(key=lambda x: x[0].info().name)
 166            clist.reverse()
 167            return clist
 168
 169        @staticmethod
 170        def amount_descending(cardlist):
 171
 172            clist = cardlist.copy()
 173            clist.sort(key=lambda x: x[1])
 174            return clist
 175
 176        @staticmethod
 177        def amount_ascending(cardlist):
 178
 179            clist = cardlist.copy()
 180            clist.sort(key=lambda x: x[1])
 181            clist.reverse()
 182            return clist

 187    class FocusedTextInputFrame(Frame):
 188
 189        TEXT_ENTERED = R_ID()
 190        ESCAPE = R_ID()
 191
 192        def __init__(
 193                    self,
 194                    frame_dim,
 195                    focus_group=""
 196                    ):
 197
 198            #initializing
 199            Frame.__init__(self, FrameEnums.UNDEFINED, None, frame_dim, focus_group=focus_group)
 200
 201            self.surface = None
 202            self.text_input = None
 203            self.text_input_frame = None
 204
 205            self.background_color = Colors.BLACK
 206            self.background_alpha = 127
 207
 208            self.escape_released = False
 209
 210            #how the frame was exited
 211            self._exit_type = None
 212
 213            self.rerender()
 214
 215        def rerender(self):
 216
 217            self.surface = pygame.Surface((self.width, self.height), pygame.SRCALPHA)
 218
 219            self.text_input_frame = pygame.Rect(0, 0, self.width//2, self.height//20)
 220            xc, yc = graphics.get_center_with_rect(self.frame_dim, self.text_input_frame)
 221            self.text_input_frame.x = xc
 222            self.text_input_frame.y = yc
 223
 224            self.text_input = TextInput(
 225                                        self.text_input_frame,
 226                                        focus_group=self.focus_group
 227                                        )
 228            self.text_input.focus()
 229
 230
 231        def set_input_text(self, text=""):
 232            self.text_input.set_text(text)
 233
 234        def get_input_text(self):
 235            return self.text_input.get_text()
 236
 237        def bind_events(self):
 238            self.clear_event_callbacks()
 239
 240        def reset_exit_type(self):
 241            self._exit_type = None
 242
 243        def exit_with_enter(self):
 244            return (self._exit_type == RenderableCardListviewer.FocusedTextInputFrame.TEXT_ENTERED)
 245
 246        def exit_with_escape(self):
 247            return (self._exit_type == RenderableCardListviewer.FocusedTextInputFrame.ESCAPE)
 248
 249        def tick(self):
 250            self.manage_pygame_events()
 251            self.text_input.tick()
 252
 253            #polling textinput events
 254            for event in self.text_input.poll_events():
 255                if event.type == TextInput.EventTypes.ENTER_PRESSED:
 256                    self._exit_type = RenderableCardListviewer.FocusedTextInputFrame.TEXT_ENTERED
 257                    self.raise_exit_flag()
 258
 259            if self.exit_flag_raised():
 260                return None
 261
 262            if self.has_focus:
 263                #checking for any movement key
 264                if self.key_pressed(pygame.K_LEFT) or self.key_pressed(KeyAlternatives.LEFT_ALTERNATIVE)\
 265                    or self.key_pressed(pygame.K_RIGHT) or self.key_pressed(KeyAlternatives.RIGHT_ALTERNATIVE)\
 266                    or self.key_pressed(pygame.K_UP) or self.key_pressed(KeyAlternatives.UP_ALTERNATIVE)\
 267                    or self.key_pressed(pygame.K_DOWN) or self.key_pressed(KeyAlternatives.DOWN_ALTERNATIVE):
 268
 269                    self.text_input.focus()
 270
 271                if (self.key_pressed(KeyAlternatives.BACK_KEY) or self.key_pressed(pygame.K_ESCAPE)) and self.escape_released:
 272                    self._exit_type = RenderableCardListviewer.FocusedTextInputFrame.ESCAPE
 273                    self.raise_exit_flag()
 274
 275                if not (self.key_pressed(KeyAlternatives.BACK_KEY) and self.key_pressed(pygame.K_ESCAPE)) and not self.escape_released:
 276                    self.escape_released = True
 277
 278            if not self.text_input.has_focus and not self.has_focus:
 279                self.focus()
 280                self.escape_released = False
 281
 282            return self
 283
 284        def render(self, screen):
 285
 286            self.surface.fill((*self.background_color, self.background_alpha))
 287            self.text_input.render(self.surface)
 288
 289            screen.blit(self.surface, (self.x, self.y))

 677    def rerender(self):
 678        #info text calc
 679        iheight = int(self.height * self.info_text_vlen_p)
 680        self.info_text_frame = pygame.Rect( 0,
 681                                            self.height - iheight,
 682                                            int(self.width * self.info_text_hlen_p),
 683                                            iheight
 684                                            )
 685        self.info_text_surface = pygame.Surface((self.info_text_frame.width, self.info_text_frame.height), pygame.SRCALPHA)
 686        self.info_text_rendered = None
 687        #resetting card index
 688        self.selected_card_index = 0
 689        #creating the full image surface
 690        self.full_image_surface = pygame.Surface((self.width, self.height), pygame.SRCALPHA)
 691        #getting border width and height
 692        self.border_width = int(self.border_frame_margin * self.width)
 693        self.border_height = int(self.border_frame_margin * self.height)
 694        #the inner area is the frame inside without the border
 695        self.inner_area = pygame.Rect(self.x + self.border_width, self.y + self.border_height,
 696                                        self.width - 2*self.border_width, self.height - 2*self.border_height)
 697        #creating the own surface
 698        self.surface = pygame.Surface((self.width, self.height), pygame.SRCALPHA)
 699        #calculating actual border outline sizes
 700        self.border_outline_width = int(self.border_width * self.border_frame_outline_margin)
 701        self.border_outline_height = int(self.border_height * self.border_frame_outline_margin)
 702        #selecting
 703        self.used_border_outline_size = min(self.border_outline_width, self.border_outline_height)
 704        #the inner border corners
 705        self.inner_border_corners = [
 706                                    (self.border_width-self.used_border_outline_size, self.border_height - self.used_border_outline_size),
 707                                    (self.width - self.border_width, self.border_height - self.used_border_outline_size),
 708                                    (self.width - self.border_width, self.height - self.border_height + self.used_border_outline_size),
 709                                    (self.border_width - self.used_border_outline_size, self.height - self.border_height)
 710                                    ]
 711        #(rect, color)
 712        self.border_lines = [
 713                                (pygame.Rect(0, 0, self.width, self.border_height), self.border_frame_color),
 714                                (pygame.Rect(self.width - self.border_width, 0, self.border_width, self.height), self.border_frame_color),
 715                                (pygame.Rect(0, 0, self.border_width, self.height), self.border_frame_color),
 716                                (pygame.Rect(0, self.height - self.border_height, self.width, self.border_height), self.border_frame_color),
 717
 718                                #outer outline
 719                                (pygame.Rect(0, 0, self.width, self.border_outline_height), self.border_frame_outline_color),
 720                                (pygame.Rect(self.width - self.border_outline_width, 0, self.border_outline_width, self.height), self.border_frame_outline_color),
 721                                (pygame.Rect(0, 0, self.border_outline_width, self.height), self.border_frame_outline_color),
 722                                (pygame.Rect(0, self.height - self.border_outline_height, self.width, self.border_outline_height), self.border_frame_outline_color)
 723
 724                                #inner outline will be calculated
 725                            ]
 726
 727        #helper function, connects the inner border corners
 728        def rs(p1, p2):
 729
 730            x = p1[0]
 731            y = p1[1]
 732
 733            w = p2[0] - p1[0]
 734            if w == 0:
 735                w = self.used_border_outline_size
 736
 737            h = p2[1] - p1[1]
 738            if h == 0:
 739                h = self.used_border_outline_size
 740
 741            if w < 0 or h < 0:
 742
 743                x = p2[0]
 744                y = p2[1]
 745
 746                w = p1[0] - p2[0]
 747                if w == 0:
 748                    w = self.used_border_outline_size
 749
 750                h = p1[1] - p2[1]
 751                if h == 0:
 752                    h = self.used_border_outline_size
 753
 754
 755            return pygame.Rect(x, y, w, h)
 756
 757        for i in range(len(self.inner_border_corners)+1):
 758
 759            i1 = i % len(self.inner_border_corners)
 760            i2 = (i+1) % len(self.inner_border_corners)
 761
 762            p1, p2 = self.inner_border_corners[i1], self.inner_border_corners[i2]
 763
 764            self.border_lines.append((rs(p1, p2), self.border_frame_outline_color))
 765
 766        #rendering the Name Label
 767        self.menu_label_height = int(self.inner_area.height * self.menu_label_vmargin)
 768        self.menu_label_surface = pygame.Surface((self.inner_area.width, self.menu_label_height), pygame.SRCALPHA)
 769        self.menu_label_highlighted_surface = self.menu_label_surface.copy()
 770        self.menu_label_highlighted_surface.fill((*self.menu_label_highlighted_color, self.menu_label_highlighted_alpha))
 771        self.menu_label_surface_pos = (self.inner_area.x, self.inner_area.y)
 772        #calculating menu label dimensions
 773        self.menu_label_frame = self.inner_area.copy()
 774        self.menu_label_frame.height = self.menu_label_height
 775        #inner menu label is the label after applying the margins
 776        self.inner_menu_label_frame = self.menu_label_frame.copy()
 777        self.inner_menu_label_frame = graphics.apply_margins(self.inner_menu_label_frame, self.menu_label_inner_hmargin, self.menu_label_inner_vmargin)
 778
 779
 780        """
 781        -----------------------------------------
 782        MENU LABEL WIDGETS
 783        -----------------------------------------
 784        """
 785
 786        #now calculating the menu options
 787        self.menu_button_frame, self.deckname_frame, self.decksize_frame = graphics.split_rect_horizontally(
 788                                                                                                        pygame.Rect(
 789                                                                                                        self.inner_menu_label_frame.x - self.menu_label_frame.x,
 790                                                                                                        self.inner_menu_label_frame.y - self.menu_label_frame.y,
 791                                                                                                        self.inner_menu_label_frame.width, self.inner_menu_label_frame.height),
 792                                                                                                        [self.menu_label_menu_button_hmargin,
 793                                                                                                        1.0-(self.menu_label_menu_button_hmargin + self.menu_label_decksize_text_hmargin),
 794                                                                                                        self.menu_label_decksize_text_hmargin
 795                                                                                                        ]
 796                                                                                                        )
 797        #now rendering the menu items
 798        #rendering the menu button
 799        self.menu_button_unfocused_image_rendered,\
 800        self.menu_button_unfocused_image_rendered_pos = graphics.img_load_and_position(self.menu_button_unfocused_image, self.menu_button_frame)
 801        self.menu_button_focused_image_rendered,\
 802        self.menu_button_focused_image_rendered_pos = graphics.img_load_and_position(self.menu_button_focused_image, self.menu_button_frame)
 803
 804        """
 805        -----------------------------------------
 806        CARD POSITION CALCULATIONS
 807        -----------------------------------------
 808        """
 809
 810        #getting the inner area for the cardlist
 811        self.main_list_frame = self.inner_area.copy()
 812
 813        self.main_list_frame.y += self.menu_label_frame.height
 814        self.main_list_frame.height -= self.menu_label_frame.height
 815
 816        #getting the inner main list
 817        self.inner_main_list_frame = graphics.apply_margins(self.main_list_frame, self.main_list_hmargin, self.main_list_vmargin)
 818
 819        #rendering the name
 820        self.render_deckname_text()
 821        #rendering the decksize
 822        self.render_decksize_text()
 823        #creating the cardmenu
 824        self.create_dropdown_menu()
 825        #now getting the card positions
 826        self.recalculate_main_list_positions()
 827        #prerendering
 828        self.prerender()
 829

 860    def recalculate_main_list_positions(self):
 861
 862        #clearing caches#
 863        self.card_render_cache = {}
 864        self.text_render_cache = {}
 865
 866        #getting the separator width
 867        self.main_list_hseparator_width = int(self.inner_main_list_frame.width * self.main_list_separator_h_percentage)
 868        self.main_list_vseparator_height = int(self.inner_main_list_frame.height * self.main_list_separator_v_percentage)
 869        #getting the remaining width
 870        self.main_list_hseparator_size =  (self.main_list_hseparator_width // (self.cards_per_line-1) if self.cards_per_line > 1 else 0)
 871        self.main_list_vseparator_size = (self.main_list_vseparator_height // (self.cards_per_column-1) if self.cards_per_column > 1 else 0)
 872        #calculating the shown cardsizes
 873        self.main_list_cwidth = (self.inner_main_list_frame.width - self.main_list_hseparator_width) // self.cards_per_line
 874        self.main_list_cheight = (self.inner_main_list_frame.height - self.main_list_vseparator_height) // self.cards_per_column
 875
 876        gcards = self.groups[self.shown_group][RenderableCardListviewer.CARDLIST_KEY]
 877        gcards = [(key, value) for key, value in gcards.items()]
 878        self.main_list_cards = self.sorting_function(gcards)
 879
 880        #rendering all cards, and adding their position
 881        self.subtext_width = 0
 882        self.subtext_height = 0
 883        self.cardimage_width = 0
 884        self.cardimage_height = 0
 885        self.main_list_card_height = 0
 886
 887        if self.main_list_view_state == RenderableCardListviewer.SHOW_WITH_AMOUNT:
 888            self.subtext_width = self.main_list_cwidth
 889            self.subtext_height = int(self.main_list_cheight * self.subtext_margin)
 890            self.cardimage_width = self.main_list_cwidth
 891            self.cardimage_height = self.main_list_cheight - self.subtext_height
 892        else:
 893            self.subtext_width = 0
 894            self.subtext_height = 0
 895            self.cardimage_width = self.main_list_cwidth
 896            self.cardimage_height = self.main_list_cheight
 897
 898
 899        cx = self.inner_main_list_frame.x + (self.inner_main_list_frame.width // 2 - self.main_list_cwidth // 2 if self.cards_per_line == 1 else 0)
 900        cy = self.inner_main_list_frame.y + (self.inner_main_list_frame.height // 2 - self.main_list_cheight // 2 if self.cards_per_column == 1 else 0)
 901
 902        self.main_list_yscroll = 0
 903
 904        main_list_cards_index = 0
 905        count = 0
 906        card_id_index = 0
 907
 908        self.main_list_cards_dict = {}
 909        self.main_list_cards_rects = {}
 910
 911        for cardclass, amount in self.main_list_cards:
 912
 913            if amount == 0:
 914                main_list_cards_index += 1
 915                continue
 916
 917            if self.main_list_view_state == RenderableCardListviewer.SHOW_WITH_AMOUNT:
 918
 919                img_rect = pygame.Rect(cx, cy, self.cardimage_width, self.cardimage_height)

 925                    self.main_list_cards_rects[cy] = []

 927                self.main_list_cards_rects[cy].append((card_id_index, main_list_cards_index, img_rect, text_rect))
 928                self.main_list_cards_dict[card_id_index] = (main_list_cards_index, img_rect, text_rect, cy)
 929
 930                main_list_cards_index += 1
 931                card_id_index += 1
 932
 933                cx += self.main_list_cwidth + self.main_list_hseparator_size
 934
 935                if not (card_id_index) % self.cards_per_line:
 936
 937                    cx = self.inner_main_list_frame.x + (self.inner_main_list_frame.width // 2 - self.main_list_cwidth // 2 if self.cards_per_line == 1 else 0)
 938                    cy += self.main_list_cheight + self.main_list_vseparator_size
 939
 940            elif self.main_list_view_state == RenderableCardListviewer.SHOW_EACH_CARD:
 941
 942                for cardcp in range(amount):
 943
 944                    img_rect = pygame.Rect(cx, cy, self.cardimage_width, self.cardimage_height)
 945                    text_rect = pygame.Rect(cx, cy + self.cardimage_height, self.subtext_width, self.subtext_height)
 946
 947                    if cy not in self.main_list_cards_rects:
 948                        self.main_list_cards_rects[cy] = []
 949
 950                    self.main_list_cards_rects[cy].append((card_id_index, main_list_cards_index, img_rect, text_rect))
 951                    self.main_list_cards_dict[card_id_index] = (main_list_cards_index, img_rect, text_rect, cy)
 952
 953                    card_id_index += 1
 954
 955                    cx += self.main_list_cwidth + self.main_list_hseparator_size
 956
 957                    if not (card_id_index) % self.cards_per_line:
 958
 959                        cx = self.inner_main_list_frame.x + (self.inner_main_list_frame.width // 2 - self.main_list_cwidth // 2 if self.cards_per_line == 1 else 0)
 960                        cy += self.main_list_cheight + self.main_list_vseparator_size

 970    def render_list_with_yscroll(self):
 971
 972        self.rendered_rows = []
 973
 974        for cy in self.main_list_cards_rects:
 975
 976            if cy + self.main_list_cheight + self.main_list_yscroll < self.inner_main_list_frame.y or\
 977                cy + self.main_list_yscroll > self.inner_main_list_frame.y + self.inner_main_list_frame.height:
 978                continue
 979
 980
 981            for id_index, main_list_cards_idx, img_rect, text_rect in self.main_list_cards_rects[cy]:
 982
 983
 984                self.rendered_rows.append((cy, id_index, main_list_cards_idx, img_rect, text_rect))
 985                cinfo = self.main_list_cards[main_list_cards_idx][0].info()
 986
 987                img_rerender_needed = True
 988                img, img_pos = None, None
 989                if cinfo.card_image_path in self.card_render_cache:
 990                    img, img_pos, cached_img_rect = self.card_render_cache[cinfo.card_image_path]
 991                    if cached_img_rect == img_rect:
 992                        img_rerender_needed = False
 993
 994                if img_rerender_needed:
 995                    img, img_pos = graphics.img_load_and_position(cinfo.card_image_path, pygame.Rect(0, 0, img_rect.width, img_rect.height))
 996                    self.card_render_cache[cinfo.card_image_path] = (img, img_pos, img_rect.copy())
 997
 998                img_render_pos = (img_rect.x + img_pos[0], img_rect.y + img_pos[1] + self.main_list_yscroll)
 999
1000                shadow_rect = None
1001
1002
1003                if self.selected_card_index == id_index and self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.MAIN_LIST_FOCUSED:
1004
1005                    #scaling up selected card
1006                    img_x_inc, img_y_inc = img.get_width() * 0.1, img.get_height() * 0.1
1007                    img = pygame.transform.smoothscale(img, (img.get_width() + img_x_inc, img.get_height() + img_y_inc))
1008                    img_render_pos = (img_render_pos[0]  - img_x_inc // 2, img_render_pos[1] - img_y_inc // 2)
1009
1010                shadow_rect = pygame.Rect(img_render_pos[0], img_render_pos[1], img.get_width(), img.get_height())
1011                shadow_rect.x += int(self.cardshadow_hoffset_p * shadow_rect.width)
1012                shadow_rect.y += int(self.cardshadow_voffset_p * shadow_rect.height)
1013
1014                shadow_color = ((*Colors.BLACK, self.cardshadow_alpha) if (id_index != self.selected_card_index or self.state != RenderableCardListviewer.MAIN_LIST_FOCUSED)\
1015                                else (*Colors.YELLOW, self.selected_cardshadow_alpha))
1016
1017                shadow_surf = pygame.Surface((shadow_rect.width, shadow_rect.height), pygame.SRCALPHA)
1018                shadow_surf.fill(shadow_color)
1019
1020                self.surface.blit(shadow_surf, (shadow_rect.x, shadow_rect.y))
1021                self.surface.blit(img, img_render_pos)
1022
1023                amount = self.main_list_cards[main_list_cards_idx][1]
1024
1025                if self.main_list_view_state == RenderableCardListviewer.SHOW_WITH_AMOUNT:
1026
1027                    trend = None
1028
1029                    txt_rerender_needed = True
1030                    if amount in self.text_render_cache:
1031                        trend, cached_txt_rect = self.text_render_cache[amount]
1032                        if cached_txt_rect == text_rect:
1033                            txt_rerender_needed = False
1034                    if txt_rerender_needed:
1035                        trend = graphics.render_page_from_chars(self.font, [f"x{amount}"], pygame.Rect(0, 0, text_rect.width, text_rect.height),
1036                                                                self.card_text_description_color, centered=True, vertical_centered=True
1037                                                                )
1038                        self.text_render_cache[amount] = (trend, text_rect.copy())
1039
1040                    for surf, pos in trend:
1041                        self.surface.blit(surf, (pos[0] + text_rect.x, pos[1] + text_rect.y + self.main_list_yscroll))
1042
1043        #finally sort the l
1044        self.rendered_rows.sort(key=lambda cy: cy[0])
1045

1207                                }

1209        if self.main_list_view_state == RenderableCardListviewer.SHOW_WITH_AMOUNT:

1228    def handle_dropdown_menu_selection(self, event):
1229
1230        if event.type == ScrollableDropdownMenu.EventTypes.SELECTION_FINISHED_EVENT:
1231            #selection was done
1232            if self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.DROPDOWN_MENU_ACTIVE:
1233                #getting the selected instance
1234                full_trace = event.data
1235                selection = RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_OPTIONS.get_option_from_traceback(event.data)
1236
1237                if selection == RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_OPTIONS.RANDOMIZED_SORTING:
1238                    self.sorting_function = RenderableCardListviewer.SortingFunctions.randomized
1239                    self.main_list_cards = self.sorting_function(self.main_list_cards)
1240                    self.recalculate_main_list_positions()
1241                elif selection == RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_OPTIONS.NAME_DESCENDING_SORTING:
1242                    if self.sorting_function is not RenderableCardListviewer.SortingFunctions.name_descending:
1243                        self.sorting_function = RenderableCardListviewer.SortingFunctions.name_descending
1244                        self.main_list_cards = self.sorting_function(self.main_list_cards)
1245                        self.recalculate_main_list_positions()
1246                elif selection == RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_OPTIONS.NAME_ASCENDING_SORTING:
1247                    if self.sorting_function is not RenderableCardListviewer.SortingFunctions.name_ascending:
1248                        self.sorting_function = RenderableCardListviewer.SortingFunctions.name_ascending
1249                        self.main_list_cards = self.sorting_function(self.main_list_cards)
1250                        self.recalculate_main_list_positions()
1251                elif selection == RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_OPTIONS.AMOUNT_DESCENDING_SORTING:
1252                    if self.sorting_function is not RenderableCardListviewer.SortingFunctions.amount_descending:
1253                        self.sorting_function = RenderableCardListviewer.SortingFunctions.amount_descending
1254                        self.main_list_cards = self.sorting_function(self.main_list_cards)
1255                        self.recalculate_main_list_positions()
1256                elif selection == RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_OPTIONS.AMOUNT_ASCENDING_SORTING:
1257                    if self.sorting_function is not RenderableCardListviewer.SortingFunctions.amount_ascending:
1258                        self.sorting_function = RenderableCardListviewer.SortingFunctions.amount_ascending
1259                        self.main_list_cards = self.sorting_function(self.main_list_cards)
1260                        self.recalculate_main_list_positions()
1261
1262                #display types
1263                elif selection == RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_OPTIONS.SHOW_EACH_CARD_DISPLAY_TYPE:
1264                    if self.main_list_view_state != RenderableCardListviewer.SHOW_EACH_CARD:
1265                        self.main_list_view_state = RenderableCardListviewer.SHOW_EACH_CARD
1266                        self.recalculate_main_list_positions()
1267
1268                elif selection == RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_OPTIONS.SHOW_WITH_AMOUNT_DISPLAY_TYPE:
1269                    if self.main_list_view_state != RenderableCardListviewer.SHOW_WITH_AMOUNT:
1270                        self.main_list_view_state = RenderableCardListviewer.SHOW_WITH_AMOUNT
1271                        self.recalculate_main_list_positions()
1272
1273                #group selection
1274                elif full_trace[:-1] == [RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_OPTIONS.SELECT_GROUP_OPTION_KEY]:
1275
1276                    self.shown_group = selection[0]
1277                    self.reload_current_group()
1278
1279                elif selection == RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_OPTIONS.CREATE_GROUP_OPTION_KEY:
1280                    self.initialize_deck_creation_frame()
1281
1282                self.reload_dropdown_menu_with_progress()
1283
1284

1318    def bind_events(self):
1319        self.clear_event_callbacks()
1320
1321    def tick(self):
1322        self.manage_pygame_events()
1323
1324        if self.exit_flag_raised():
1325            return None
1326
1327        if self.is_focused():
1328            if self.info_text_active():
1329                self.info_text_tick()
1330
1331            #dropdown events
1332            dropdown_events = self.dropdown_menu.poll_events()
1333
1334            if self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.DROPDOWN_MENU_ACTIVE:
1335                self.dropdown_menu.tick()
1336
1337            for event in dropdown_events:
1338                self.handle_dropdown_menu_selection(event)
1339
1340            #non input accepting states
1341            if self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.MOVING_ONE_ROW_UP:
1342                self.move_one_row_up()
1343            elif self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.MOVING_ONE_ROW_DOWN:
1344                self.move_one_row_down()
1345            elif self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.MOVING_ALL_ROWS_UP:
1346                self.move_all_rows_up()
1347            elif self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.FULL_IMAGE_SHOWN:
1348                if not self.key_pressed(KeyAlternatives.SHOW_IMAGE_KEY):
1349                    self.state = RenderableCardListviewer.MAIN_LIST_FOCUSED
1350            elif self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.DECKNAME_SELECTED_ANIMATION:
1351                self.deckname_selected_animation()
1352            elif self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_BUTTON_SELECTED_ANIMATION:
1353                self.menu_button_selected_animation()
1354            elif self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.INITIALIZE_DECK_RENAMING_FRAME:
1355                self.initialize_deck_renaming_frame()
1356            elif self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.CARD_SNAPBACK_ANIMATION:
1357                self.card_snapback_animation()
1358            elif self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.ENTER_PRESSED:
1359                if not (self.key_pressed(pygame.K_RETURN) or self.key_pressed(KeyAlternatives.ENTER_ALTERNATIVE)):
1360                    if self.prev_state == RenderableCardListviewer.MAIN_LIST_FOCUSED and self.n_cards_shown > 0:
1361                        #if a card was focused, we need to animate putting it back in its original state
1362                        self.state = RenderableCardListviewer.CARD_SNAPBACK_ANIMATION
1363                        self.initialize_card_snapback_animation()
1364                    else:
1365                        self.state = self.prev_state
1366                        if self.enter_clock.elapsed() >= self.time_until_long_enter_pressed:
1367                            self.long_enter_pressed()
1368                        else:
1369                            self.enter_pressed()
1370                        self.key_clock.start()
1371                else:
1372                    if self.prev_state == RenderableCardListviewer.MAIN_LIST_FOCUSED and self.n_cards_shown > 0:
1373                        self.card_pressed_animation()
1374            elif self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.DECK_RENAMING_FRAME_ACTIVE:
1375                ret = self.focused_text_input_subframe.tick()
1376
1377                if ret is None:
1378
1379                    #setting the groupname
1380                    if self.focused_text_input_subframe.exit_with_enter():
1381
1382                        text = self.focused_text_input_subframe.get_input_text()
1383
1384                        if not text or text in list(self.groups.keys()):
1385                            tcolor = (RenderableCardListviewer.INFO_TEXT_ERROR_COLOR if self.info_text_error_color is None else self.info_text_error_color)
1386
1387                            self.print_info_text(
1388                                                    [[(RenderableCardListviewer.DECKNAME_ALREADY_EXISTS_ERROR_INFO_TEXT, tcolor)]],
1389                                                    tcolor,
1390                                                    RenderableCardListviewer.DECKNAME_ALREADY_EXISTS_ERROR_FADING_DURATION
1391                                                )
1392
1393                            self.focused_text_input_subframe.reset_exit_flag()
1394                            self.focused_text_input_subframe.reset_exit_type()
1395
1396                        else:
1397
1398                            data_cp = deepcopy(self.groups[self.shown_group])
1399                            del self.groups[self.shown_group]
1400                            self.shown_group = self.focused_text_input_subframe.get_input_text()
1401                            self.groups[self.shown_group] = data_cp
1402                            self.focused_text_input_subframe = None
1403                            self.focus()
1404                            self.state = RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_DECKNAME_FOCUSED
1405                            self.render_deckname_text()
1406                            self.create_dropdown_menu()
1407
1408                    elif self.focused_text_input_subframe.exit_with_escape():
1409                        self.focused_text_input_subframe = None
1410                        self.state = RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_DECKNAME_FOCUSED
1411
1412                    self.key_clock.start()
1413
1414            elif self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.DECK_CREATION_FRAME_ACTIVE:
1415                ret = self.focused_text_input_subframe.tick()
1416
1417                if ret is None:
1418                    self.finalize_deck_creation_frame()
1419
1420                self.key_clock.start()
1421
1422            else:
1423                #accept inputs
1424
1425                if self.key_clock.elapsed() > self.key_delay:
1426
1427                    if self.key_pressed(pygame.K_ESCAPE):
1428                        self.escape_pressed()
1429                        self.key_clock.start()
1430
1431                    if self.key_pressed(pygame.K_LEFT) or self.key_pressed(KeyAlternatives.LEFT_ALTERNATIVE):
1432                        self.left_pressed()
1433                        self.key_clock.start()
1434
1435                    if self.key_pressed(pygame.K_RIGHT) or self.key_pressed(KeyAlternatives.RIGHT_ALTERNATIVE):
1436                        self.right_pressed()
1437                        self.key_clock.start()
1438
1439                    if self.key_pressed(pygame.K_UP) or self.key_pressed(KeyAlternatives.UP_ALTERNATIVE):
1440                        self.up_pressed()
1441                        self.key_clock.start()
1442
1443                    if self.key_pressed(pygame.K_DOWN) or self.key_pressed(KeyAlternatives.DOWN_ALTERNATIVE):
1444                        self.down_pressed()
1445                        self.key_clock.start()
1446
1447                    if self.key_pressed(KeyAlternatives.SHOW_IMAGE_KEY):
1448                        self.state = RenderableCardListviewer.FULL_IMAGE_SHOWN
1449                        self.prerender_full_image()
1450                        self.key_clock.start()
1451
1452                    if self.key_pressed(pygame.K_RETURN) or self.key_pressed(KeyAlternatives.ENTER_ALTERNATIVE):
1453
1454                        if self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.MAIN_LIST_FOCUSED and self.n_cards_shown > 0:
1455                            self.cards_dict_before_enter = self.main_list_cards_dict[self.selected_card_index]
1456                            self.cards_rects_before_enter = self.main_list_cards_rects[self.cards_dict_before_enter[3]]#the cy
1457                            self.cards_rects_before_enter_index = [i for i in range(len(self.cards_rects_before_enter)) if self.cards_rects_before_enter[i][0] == self.selected_card_index][0]
1458                        self.state = RenderableCardListviewer.ENTER_PRESSED
1459                        self.enter_clock.start()
1460                        self.key_clock.start()
1461
1462                    if self.key_pressed(pygame.K_BACKSPACE) or self.key_pressed(KeyAlternatives.BACK_KEY):
1463                        self.back_pressed()
1464                        self.key_clock.start()
1465
1466        return self
1467    """

1471    def left_pressed(self):
1472
1473        if self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.NOTHING_FOCUSED:
1474            self.state = RenderableCardListviewer.MAIN_LIST_FOCUSED
1475            self.selected_card_index = 0
1476        elif self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.MAIN_LIST_FOCUSED:
1477            #if we're at the leftmost state, leave the main list focus
1478            if (self.selected_card_index % self.cards_per_line) == 0:
1479                self.state = RenderableCardListviewer.NOTHING_FOCUSED
1480            else:
1481                self.selected_card_index -= 1
1482        elif self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_BUTTON_FOCUSED:
1483            self.state = RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_DECKSIZE_FOCUSED
1484        elif self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_DECKSIZE_FOCUSED:
1485            self.state = RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_DECKNAME_FOCUSED
1486        elif self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_DECKNAME_FOCUSED:
1487            self.state = RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_BUTTON_FOCUSED
1488        elif self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.DROPDOWN_MENU_ACTIVE:
1489            self.dropdown_menu.move_left()
1490
1491    def right_pressed(self):
1492
1493        if self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.NOTHING_FOCUSED:
1494            self.state = RenderableCardListviewer.MAIN_LIST_FOCUSED
1495            self.selected_card_index = 0
1496        elif self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.MAIN_LIST_FOCUSED:
1497            #if we're at the rightmost state, leave the main list focus
1498            if ((self.selected_card_index + 1) % self.cards_per_line) == 0:
1499                self.state = RenderableCardListviewer.NOTHING_FOCUSED
1500            else:
1501                self.selected_card_index += 1
1502
1503        elif self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_BUTTON_FOCUSED:
1504            self.state = RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_DECKNAME_FOCUSED
1505        elif self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_DECKNAME_FOCUSED:
1506            self.state = RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_DECKSIZE_FOCUSED
1507        elif self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_DECKSIZE_FOCUSED:
1508            self.state = RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_BUTTON_FOCUSED
1509        elif self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.DROPDOWN_MENU_ACTIVE:
1510            self.dropdown_menu.move_right()
1511
1512    def up_pressed(self):
1513
1514        if self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.NOTHING_FOCUSED:
1515            self.state = RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_BUTTON_FOCUSED
1516
1517        elif self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_BUTTON_FOCUSED\
1518            or self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_DECKNAME_FOCUSED\
1519            or self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_DECKSIZE_FOCUSED:
1520
1521            self.state = RenderableCardListviewer.NOTHING_FOCUSED
1522
1523        elif self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.MAIN_LIST_FOCUSED:
1524
1525            if self.n_cards_shown == 0:
1526                self.state = RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_BUTTON_FOCUSED
1527                return
1528
1529            if self.key_pressed(pygame.K_LSHIFT):
1530                if not self.fastscroll_enabled:
1531                    self.fastscroll_enabled = True
1532                    self.rowscroll_copy = self.rowscrolling_duration
1533                    self.rowscrolling_duration = self.fastscroll_duration
1534            elif self.fastscroll_enabled:
1535                self.fastscroll_enabled = False
1536                self.rowscrolling_duration = self.rowscroll_copy
1537            #check for going off, and if the index is in rendered rows
1538            if self.selected_card_index < self.cards_per_line:
1539                self.state = RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_BUTTON_FOCUSED
1540            elif (self.selected_card_index - self.cards_per_line) not in [x[1] for x in self.rendered_rows]:
1541                self.state = RenderableCardListviewer.MOVING_ONE_ROW_UP
1542                self.initialize_move_one_row_up()
1543            else:
1544                self.selected_card_index -= self.cards_per_line
1545
1546        elif self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.DROPDOWN_MENU_ACTIVE:
1547            self.dropdown_menu.move_up()
1548
1549    def down_pressed(self):
1550
1551        if self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.NOTHING_FOCUSED:
1552            self.state = RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_BUTTON_FOCUSED
1553
1554        elif self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_BUTTON_FOCUSED\
1555            or self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_DECKNAME_FOCUSED\
1556            or self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_DECKSIZE_FOCUSED:
1557
1558            self.state = RenderableCardListviewer.MAIN_LIST_FOCUSED
1559            self.selected_card_index = 0
1560            self.main_list_yscroll = 0
1561
1562        elif self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.MAIN_LIST_FOCUSED:
1563
1564            if self.n_cards_shown == 0:
1565                self.state = RenderableCardListviewer.NOTHING_FOCUSED
1566                return
1567            #check for going off, and if the index is in rendered rows
1568            if self.key_pressed(pygame.K_LSHIFT):
1569                if not self.fastscroll_enabled:
1570                    self.fastscroll_enabled = True
1571                    self.rowscroll_copy = self.rowscrolling_duration
1572                    self.rowscrolling_duration = self.fastscroll_duration
1573            elif self.fastscroll_enabled:
1574                self.fastscroll_enabled = False
1575                self.rowscrolling_duration = self.rowscroll_copy
1576
1577            if self.selected_card_index >= (self.n_cards_shown - self.cards_per_line):
1578                self.selected_card_index += self.cards_per_line
1579                self.selected_card_index %= (self.n_cards_shown)
1580                self.selected_card_index -= (self.cards_per_line - self.n_cards_shown % self.cards_per_line)
1581                if self.selected_card_index < self.cards_per_line:
1582                    self.state = RenderableCardListviewer.MOVING_ALL_ROWS_UP
1583                    self.initialize_move_all_rows_up()
1584            elif len(self.rendered_rows) < (self.cards_per_line * self.cards_per_column):
1585                self.selected_card_index += self.cards_per_line
1586                self.selected_card_index %= self.n_cards_shown
1587            elif (self.selected_card_index + self.cards_per_line) not in [x[1] for x in self.rendered_rows]:
1588
1589                self.state = RenderableCardListviewer.MOVING_ONE_ROW_DOWN
1590                self.initialize_move_one_row_down()
1591            else:
1592                self.selected_card_index += self.cards_per_line
1593
1594        elif self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.DROPDOWN_MENU_ACTIVE:
1595            self.dropdown_menu.move_down()
1596
1597

1873    def card_pressed_animation(self):

1878        self.enter_pressed_on_card_percentage = percentage
1879        #changing the frame dimensions
1880
1881        main_list_index, img_rect, txt_rect, cy = self.cards_dict_before_enter
1882        card_id_index, main_list_cards_index, _1, _2 = self.cards_rects_before_enter[self.cards_rects_before_enter_index]
1883

1898
1899        if percentage >= 1.0:
1900            self.finalize_card_snapback_animation()
1901        else:
1902
1903            main_list_index, img_rect, txt_rect, cy = self.cards_dict_before_enter
1904            card_id_index, main_list_cards_index, _1, _2 = self.cards_rects_before_enter[self.cards_rects_before_enter_index]
1905
1906            size_margin = (self.enter_pressed_on_card_percentage * self.card_pressed_size_change_percentage) * (1.0 - percentage)
1907            img_rect = graphics.apply_margins(img_rect, size_margin, size_margin)
1908            txt_rect = graphics.apply_margins(txt_rect, size_margin, size_margin)
1909
1910            self.main_list_cards_dict[card_id_index] = (main_list_index, img_rect, txt_rect, cy)
1911            self.main_list_cards_rects[cy][self.cards_rects_before_enter_index] = (card_id_index, main_list_cards_index, img_rect, txt_rect)
1912
1913
1914    def finalize_card_snapback_animation(self):
1915
1916        main_list_index, img_rect, txt_rect, cy = self.cards_dict_before_enter
1917        card_id_index, main_list_cards_index, _1, _2 = self.cards_rects_before_enter[self.cards_rects_before_enter_index]
1918
1919        self.main_list_cards_dict[card_id_index] = self.cards_dict_before_enter
1920        self.main_list_cards_rects[cy][self.cards_rects_before_enter_index] = (card_id_index, main_list_cards_index, img_rect, txt_rect)
1921
1922        self.state = RenderableCardListviewer.MAIN_LIST_FOCUSED
1923
1924        if fequal(self.enter_pressed_on_card_percentage, 1.0):
1925            self.long_enter_pressed()
1926        else:
1927            self.enter_pressed()

 138    class SortingFunctions:
 139
 140        """
 141        Functions to sort cardlists.
 142        Each cardlist is: [(RenderableCard (Class), amount)]
 143        """
 144
 145        @staticmethod
 146        def no_order(cardlist):
 147            return cardlist
 148
 149        @staticmethod
 150        def randomized(cardlist):
 151            cardlist_copy = cardlist.copy()
 152            random.shuffle(cardlist_copy)
 153            return cardlist_copy
 154
 155        @staticmethod
 156        def name_descending(cardlist):
 157
 158            clist = cardlist.copy()
 159            clist.sort(key=lambda x: x[0].info().name)
 160            return clist
 161
 162        @staticmethod
 163        def name_ascending(cardlist):
 164
 165            clist = cardlist.copy()
 166            clist.sort(key=lambda x: x[0].info().name)
 167            clist.reverse()
 168            return clist
 169
 170        @staticmethod
 171        def amount_descending(cardlist):
 172
 173            clist = cardlist.copy()
 174            clist.sort(key=lambda x: x[1])
 175            return clist
 176
 177        @staticmethod
 178        def amount_ascending(cardlist):
 179
 180            clist = cardlist.copy()
 181            clist.sort(key=lambda x: x[1])
 182            clist.reverse()
 183            return clist

 188    class FocusedTextInputFrame(Frame):
 189
 190        TEXT_ENTERED = R_ID()
 191        ESCAPE = R_ID()
 192
 193        def __init__(
 194                    self,
 195                    frame_dim,
 196                    focus_group=""
 197                    ):
 198
 199            #initializing
 200            Frame.__init__(self, FrameEnums.UNDEFINED, None, frame_dim, focus_group=focus_group)
 201
 202            self.surface = None
 203            self.text_input = None
 204            self.text_input_frame = None
 205
 206            self.background_color = Colors.BLACK
 207            self.background_alpha = 127
 208
 209            self.escape_released = False
 210
 211            #how the frame was exited
 212            self._exit_type = None
 213
 214            self.rerender()
 215
 216        def rerender(self):
 217
 218            self.surface = pygame.Surface((self.width, self.height), pygame.SRCALPHA)
 219
 220            self.text_input_frame = pygame.Rect(0, 0, self.width//2, self.height//20)
 221            xc, yc = graphics.get_center_with_rect(self.frame_dim, self.text_input_frame)
 222            self.text_input_frame.x = xc
 223            self.text_input_frame.y = yc
 224
 225            self.text_input = TextInput(
 226                                        self.text_input_frame,
 227                                        focus_group=self.focus_group
 228                                        )
 229            self.text_input.focus()
 230
 231
 232        def set_input_text(self, text=""):
 233            self.text_input.set_text(text)
 234
 235        def get_input_text(self):
 236            return self.text_input.get_text()
 237
 238        def bind_events(self):
 239            self.clear_event_callbacks()
 240
 241        def reset_exit_type(self):
 242            self._exit_type = None
 243
 244        def exit_with_enter(self):
 245            return (self._exit_type == RenderableCardListviewer.FocusedTextInputFrame.TEXT_ENTERED)
 246
 247        def exit_with_escape(self):
 248            return (self._exit_type == RenderableCardListviewer.FocusedTextInputFrame.ESCAPE)
 249
 250        def tick(self):
 251            self.manage_pygame_events()
 252            self.text_input.tick()
 253
 254            #polling textinput events
 255            for event in self.text_input.poll_events():
 256                if event.type == TextInput.EventTypes.ENTER_PRESSED:
 257                    self._exit_type = RenderableCardListviewer.FocusedTextInputFrame.TEXT_ENTERED
 258                    self.raise_exit_flag()
 259
 260            if self.exit_flag_raised():
 261                return None
 262
 263            if self.has_focus:
 264                #checking for any movement key
 265                if self.key_pressed(pygame.K_LEFT) or self.key_pressed(KeyAlternatives.LEFT_ALTERNATIVE)\
 266                    or self.key_pressed(pygame.K_RIGHT) or self.key_pressed(KeyAlternatives.RIGHT_ALTERNATIVE)\
 267                    or self.key_pressed(pygame.K_UP) or self.key_pressed(KeyAlternatives.UP_ALTERNATIVE)\
 268                    or self.key_pressed(pygame.K_DOWN) or self.key_pressed(KeyAlternatives.DOWN_ALTERNATIVE):
 269
 270                    self.text_input.focus()
 271
 272                if (self.key_pressed(KeyAlternatives.BACK_KEY) or self.key_pressed(pygame.K_ESCAPE)) and self.escape_released:
 273                    self._exit_type = RenderableCardListviewer.FocusedTextInputFrame.ESCAPE
 274                    self.raise_exit_flag()
 275
 276                if not (self.key_pressed(KeyAlternatives.BACK_KEY) and self.key_pressed(pygame.K_ESCAPE)) and not self.escape_released:
 277                    self.escape_released = True
 278
 279            if not self.text_input.has_focus and not self.has_focus:
 280                self.focus()
 281                self.escape_released = False
 282
 283            return self
 284
 285        def render(self, screen):
 286
 287            self.surface.fill((*self.background_color, self.background_alpha))
 288            self.text_input.render(self.surface)
 289
 290            screen.blit(self.surface, (self.x, self.y))

 689        self.selected_card_index = 0
 690        #creating the full image surface
 691        self.full_image_surface = pygame.Surface((self.width, self.height), pygame.SRCALPHA)
 692        #getting border width and height
 693        self.border_width = int(self.border_frame_margin * self.width)
 694        self.border_height = int(self.border_frame_margin * self.height)
 695        #the inner area is the frame inside without the border
 696        self.inner_area = pygame.Rect(self.x + self.border_width, self.y + self.border_height,
 697                                        self.width - 2*self.border_width, self.height - 2*self.border_height)
 698        #creating the own surface
 699        self.surface = pygame.Surface((self.width, self.height), pygame.SRCALPHA)
 700        #calculating actual border outline sizes
 701        self.border_outline_width = int(self.border_width * self.border_frame_outline_margin)
 702        self.border_outline_height = int(self.border_height * self.border_frame_outline_margin)
 703        #selecting
 704        self.used_border_outline_size = min(self.border_outline_width, self.border_outline_height)
 705        #the inner border corners
 706        self.inner_border_corners = [
 707                                    (self.border_width-self.used_border_outline_size, self.border_height - self.used_border_outline_size),
 708                                    (self.width - self.border_width, self.border_height - self.used_border_outline_size),
 709                                    (self.width - self.border_width, self.height - self.border_height + self.used_border_outline_size),
 710                                    (self.border_width - self.used_border_outline_size, self.height - self.border_height)
 711                                    ]
 712        #(rect, color)
 713        self.border_lines = [
 714                                (pygame.Rect(0, 0, self.width, self.border_height), self.border_frame_color),
 715                                (pygame.Rect(self.width - self.border_width, 0, self.border_width, self.height), self.border_frame_color),
 716                                (pygame.Rect(0, 0, self.border_width, self.height), self.border_frame_color),
 717                                (pygame.Rect(0, self.height - self.border_height, self.width, self.border_height), self.border_frame_color),
 718
 719                                #outer outline
 720                                (pygame.Rect(0, 0, self.width, self.border_outline_height), self.border_frame_outline_color),
 721                                (pygame.Rect(self.width - self.border_outline_width, 0, self.border_outline_width, self.height), self.border_frame_outline_color),
 722                                (pygame.Rect(0, 0, self.border_outline_width, self.height), self.border_frame_outline_color),
 723                                (pygame.Rect(0, self.height - self.border_outline_height, self.width, self.border_outline_height), self.border_frame_outline_color)
 724
 725                                #inner outline will be calculated
 726                            ]
 727
 728        #helper function, connects the inner border corners
 729        def rs(p1, p2):
 730
 731            x = p1[0]
 732            y = p1[1]
 733
 734            w = p2[0] - p1[0]
 735            if w == 0:
 736                w = self.used_border_outline_size
 737
 738            h = p2[1] - p1[1]
 739            if h == 0:
 740                h = self.used_border_outline_size
 741
 742            if w < 0 or h < 0:
 743
 744                x = p2[0]
 745                y = p2[1]
 746
 747                w = p1[0] - p2[0]
 748                if w == 0:
 749                    w = self.used_border_outline_size
 750
 751                h = p1[1] - p2[1]
 752                if h == 0:
 753                    h = self.used_border_outline_size
 754
 755
 756            return pygame.Rect(x, y, w, h)
 757
 758        for i in range(len(self.inner_border_corners)+1):
 759
 760            i1 = i % len(self.inner_border_corners)
 761            i2 = (i+1) % len(self.inner_border_corners)
 762
 763            p1, p2 = self.inner_border_corners[i1], self.inner_border_corners[i2]
 764
 765            self.border_lines.append((rs(p1, p2), self.border_frame_outline_color))
 766
 767        #rendering the Name Label
 768        self.menu_label_height = int(self.inner_area.height * self.menu_label_vmargin)
 769        self.menu_label_surface = pygame.Surface((self.inner_area.width, self.menu_label_height), pygame.SRCALPHA)
 770        self.menu_label_highlighted_surface = self.menu_label_surface.copy()
 771        self.menu_label_highlighted_surface.fill((*self.menu_label_highlighted_color, self.menu_label_highlighted_alpha))
 772        self.menu_label_surface_pos = (self.inner_area.x, self.inner_area.y)
 773        #calculating menu label dimensions
 774        self.menu_label_frame = self.inner_area.copy()
 775        self.menu_label_frame.height = self.menu_label_height
 776        #inner menu label is the label after applying the margins
 777        self.inner_menu_label_frame = self.menu_label_frame.copy()
 778        self.inner_menu_label_frame = graphics.apply_margins(self.inner_menu_label_frame, self.menu_label_inner_hmargin, self.menu_label_inner_vmargin)
 779
 780

 786

 788        self.menu_button_frame, self.deckname_frame, self.decksize_frame = graphics.split_rect_horizontally(
 789                                                                                                        pygame.Rect(
 790                                                                                                        self.inner_menu_label_frame.x - self.menu_label_frame.x,

 793                                                                                                        [self.menu_label_menu_button_hmargin,
 794                                                                                                        1.0-(self.menu_label_menu_button_hmargin + self.menu_label_decksize_text_hmargin),
 795                                                                                                        self.menu_label_decksize_text_hmargin

 800        self.menu_button_unfocused_image_rendered,\

 802        self.menu_button_focused_image_rendered,\
 803        self.menu_button_focused_image_rendered_pos = graphics.img_load_and_position(self.menu_button_focused_image, self.menu_button_frame)

 811        #getting the inner area for the cardlist

 813

 815        self.main_list_frame.height -= self.menu_label_frame.height

 861    def recalculate_main_list_positions(self):
 862
 863        #clearing caches#
 864        self.card_render_cache = {}
 865        self.text_render_cache = {}
 866
 867        #getting the separator width
 868        self.main_list_hseparator_width = int(self.inner_main_list_frame.width * self.main_list_separator_h_percentage)
 869        self.main_list_vseparator_height = int(self.inner_main_list_frame.height * self.main_list_separator_v_percentage)
 870        #getting the remaining width
 871        self.main_list_hseparator_size =  (self.main_list_hseparator_width // (self.cards_per_line-1) if self.cards_per_line > 1 else 0)
 872        self.main_list_vseparator_size = (self.main_list_vseparator_height // (self.cards_per_column-1) if self.cards_per_column > 1 else 0)
 873        #calculating the shown cardsizes
 874        self.main_list_cwidth = (self.inner_main_list_frame.width - self.main_list_hseparator_width) // self.cards_per_line
 875        self.main_list_cheight = (self.inner_main_list_frame.height - self.main_list_vseparator_height) // self.cards_per_column
 876
 877        gcards = self.groups[self.shown_group][RenderableCardListviewer.CARDLIST_KEY]
 878        gcards = [(key, value) for key, value in gcards.items()]
 879        self.main_list_cards = self.sorting_function(gcards)
 880
 881        #rendering all cards, and adding their position
 882        self.subtext_width = 0
 883        self.subtext_height = 0
 884        self.cardimage_width = 0
 885        self.cardimage_height = 0
 886        self.main_list_card_height = 0
 887
 888        if self.main_list_view_state == RenderableCardListviewer.SHOW_WITH_AMOUNT:
 889            self.subtext_width = self.main_list_cwidth
 890            self.subtext_height = int(self.main_list_cheight * self.subtext_margin)
 891            self.cardimage_width = self.main_list_cwidth
 892            self.cardimage_height = self.main_list_cheight - self.subtext_height
 893        else:
 894            self.subtext_width = 0
 895            self.subtext_height = 0
 896            self.cardimage_width = self.main_list_cwidth
 897            self.cardimage_height = self.main_list_cheight
 898
 899
 900        cx = self.inner_main_list_frame.x + (self.inner_main_list_frame.width // 2 - self.main_list_cwidth // 2 if self.cards_per_line == 1 else 0)
 901        cy = self.inner_main_list_frame.y + (self.inner_main_list_frame.height // 2 - self.main_list_cheight // 2 if self.cards_per_column == 1 else 0)
 902
 903        self.main_list_yscroll = 0
 904
 905        main_list_cards_index = 0
 906        count = 0
 907        card_id_index = 0
 908
 909        self.main_list_cards_dict = {}
 910        self.main_list_cards_rects = {}
 911
 912        for cardclass, amount in self.main_list_cards:
 913
 914            if amount == 0:
 915                main_list_cards_index += 1
 916                continue
 917
 918            if self.main_list_view_state == RenderableCardListviewer.SHOW_WITH_AMOUNT:
 919
 920                img_rect = pygame.Rect(cx, cy, self.cardimage_width, self.cardimage_height)
 921                text_rect = pygame.Rect(cx, cy + self.cardimage_height, self.subtext_width, self.subtext_height)
 922                #applying the margins
 923                text_rect = graphics.apply_margins(text_rect, self.cardtext_hmargin, self.cardtext_vmargin)
 924
 925                if cy not in self.main_list_cards_rects:
 926                    self.main_list_cards_rects[cy] = []
 927
 928                self.main_list_cards_rects[cy].append((card_id_index, main_list_cards_index, img_rect, text_rect))
 929                self.main_list_cards_dict[card_id_index] = (main_list_cards_index, img_rect, text_rect, cy)
 930
 931                main_list_cards_index += 1
 932                card_id_index += 1
 933
 934                cx += self.main_list_cwidth + self.main_list_hseparator_size
 935
 936                if not (card_id_index) % self.cards_per_line:
 937
 938                    cx = self.inner_main_list_frame.x + (self.inner_main_list_frame.width // 2 - self.main_list_cwidth // 2 if self.cards_per_line == 1 else 0)
 939                    cy += self.main_list_cheight + self.main_list_vseparator_size
 940
 941            elif self.main_list_view_state == RenderableCardListviewer.SHOW_EACH_CARD:
 942
 943                for cardcp in range(amount):
 944
 945                    img_rect = pygame.Rect(cx, cy, self.cardimage_width, self.cardimage_height)
 946                    text_rect = pygame.Rect(cx, cy + self.cardimage_height, self.subtext_width, self.subtext_height)
 947
 948                    if cy not in self.main_list_cards_rects:
 949                        self.main_list_cards_rects[cy] = []
 950
 951                    self.main_list_cards_rects[cy].append((card_id_index, main_list_cards_index, img_rect, text_rect))
 952                    self.main_list_cards_dict[card_id_index] = (main_list_cards_index, img_rect, text_rect, cy)
 953
 954                    card_id_index += 1
 955
 956                    cx += self.main_list_cwidth + self.main_list_hseparator_size
 957
 958                    if not (card_id_index) % self.cards_per_line:
 959
 960                        cx = self.inner_main_list_frame.x + (self.inner_main_list_frame.width // 2 - self.main_list_cwidth // 2 if self.cards_per_line == 1 else 0)
 961                        cy += self.main_list_cheight + self.main_list_vseparator_size
 962
 963                main_list_cards_index += 1
 964
 965        self.n_cards_shown = card_id_index
 966

 971    def render_list_with_yscroll(self):
 972
 973        self.rendered_rows = []
 974
 975        for cy in self.main_list_cards_rects:
 976
 977            if cy + self.main_list_cheight + self.main_list_yscroll < self.inner_main_list_frame.y or\
 978                cy + self.main_list_yscroll > self.inner_main_list_frame.y + self.inner_main_list_frame.height:
 979                continue
 980
 981
 982            for id_index, main_list_cards_idx, img_rect, text_rect in self.main_list_cards_rects[cy]:
 983
 984
 985                self.rendered_rows.append((cy, id_index, main_list_cards_idx, img_rect, text_rect))
 986                cinfo = self.main_list_cards[main_list_cards_idx][0].info()
 987
 988                img_rerender_needed = True
 989                img, img_pos = None, None
 990                if cinfo.card_image_path in self.card_render_cache:
 991                    img, img_pos, cached_img_rect = self.card_render_cache[cinfo.card_image_path]
 992                    if cached_img_rect == img_rect:
 993                        img_rerender_needed = False
 994
 995                if img_rerender_needed:
 996                    img, img_pos = graphics.img_load_and_position(cinfo.card_image_path, pygame.Rect(0, 0, img_rect.width, img_rect.height))
 997                    self.card_render_cache[cinfo.card_image_path] = (img, img_pos, img_rect.copy())
 998
 999                img_render_pos = (img_rect.x + img_pos[0], img_rect.y + img_pos[1] + self.main_list_yscroll)
1000
1001                shadow_rect = None
1002
1003
1004                if self.selected_card_index == id_index and self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.MAIN_LIST_FOCUSED:
1005
1006                    #scaling up selected card
1007                    img_x_inc, img_y_inc = img.get_width() * 0.1, img.get_height() * 0.1
1008                    img = pygame.transform.smoothscale(img, (img.get_width() + img_x_inc, img.get_height() + img_y_inc))
1009                    img_render_pos = (img_render_pos[0]  - img_x_inc // 2, img_render_pos[1] - img_y_inc // 2)
1010
1011                shadow_rect = pygame.Rect(img_render_pos[0], img_render_pos[1], img.get_width(), img.get_height())
1012                shadow_rect.x += int(self.cardshadow_hoffset_p * shadow_rect.width)
1013                shadow_rect.y += int(self.cardshadow_voffset_p * shadow_rect.height)
1014
1015                shadow_color = ((*Colors.BLACK, self.cardshadow_alpha) if (id_index != self.selected_card_index or self.state != RenderableCardListviewer.MAIN_LIST_FOCUSED)\
1016                                else (*Colors.YELLOW, self.selected_cardshadow_alpha))
1017
1018                shadow_surf = pygame.Surface((shadow_rect.width, shadow_rect.height), pygame.SRCALPHA)
1019                shadow_surf.fill(shadow_color)
1020
1021                self.surface.blit(shadow_surf, (shadow_rect.x, shadow_rect.y))
1022                self.surface.blit(img, img_render_pos)
1023
1024                amount = self.main_list_cards[main_list_cards_idx][1]
1025
1026                if self.main_list_view_state == RenderableCardListviewer.SHOW_WITH_AMOUNT:
1027
1028                    trend = None
1029
1030                    txt_rerender_needed = True
1031                    if amount in self.text_render_cache:
1032                        trend, cached_txt_rect = self.text_render_cache[amount]
1033                        if cached_txt_rect == text_rect:
1034                            txt_rerender_needed = False
1035                    if txt_rerender_needed:
1036                        trend = graphics.render_page_from_chars(self.font, [f"x{amount}"], pygame.Rect(0, 0, text_rect.width, text_rect.height),
1037                                                                self.card_text_description_color, centered=True, vertical_centered=True
1038                                                                )
1039                        self.text_render_cache[amount] = (trend, text_rect.copy())
1040
1041                    for surf, pos in trend:
1042                        self.surface.blit(surf, (pos[0] + text_rect.x, pos[1] + text_rect.y + self.main_list_yscroll))
1043
1044        #finally sort the l
1045        self.rendered_rows.sort(key=lambda cy: cy[0])
1046
1047    def prerender(self):
1048        #prerendering
1049
1050        self.surface.fill(self.main_list_color)
1051        self.menu_label_surface.fill(self.menu_label_color)
1052        #rendering visible cards
1053        self.render_list_with_yscroll()
1054
1055        for rect, color in self.border_lines:
1056            pygame.draw.rect(self.surface, color, rect)
1057
1058        if self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_BUTTON_FOCUSED:
1059            self.menu_label_highlighted_surface = pygame.Surface((self.menu_button_frame.width, self.menu_button_frame.height), pygame.SRCALPHA)
1060            self.menu_label_highlighted_surface.fill((*self.menu_label_highlighted_color, self.menu_label_highlighted_alpha))
1061            self.menu_label_surface.blit(self.menu_label_highlighted_surface, (self.menu_button_frame.x, self.menu_button_frame.y))
1062        elif self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_DECKNAME_FOCUSED:
1063            self.menu_label_highlighted_surface = pygame.Surface((self.deckname_frame.width, self.deckname_frame.height), pygame.SRCALPHA)
1064            self.menu_label_highlighted_surface.fill((*self.menu_label_highlighted_color, self.menu_label_highlighted_alpha))

1073
1074                        [RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_BUTTON_FOCUSED,

1076
1077                        else self.menu_button_unfocused_image_rendered)

1080
1081                        [RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_BUTTON_FOCUSED,

1083
1084                        else self.menu_button_unfocused_image_rendered_pos)

1097            self.info_text_surface.fill((*Colors.BLACK, self.info_text_surface_alpha))

1229    def handle_dropdown_menu_selection(self, event):
1230
1231        if event.type == ScrollableDropdownMenu.EventTypes.SELECTION_FINISHED_EVENT:
1232            #selection was done
1233            if self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.DROPDOWN_MENU_ACTIVE:
1234                #getting the selected instance
1235                full_trace = event.data
1236                selection = RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_OPTIONS.get_option_from_traceback(event.data)
1237
1238                if selection == RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_OPTIONS.RANDOMIZED_SORTING:
1239                    self.sorting_function = RenderableCardListviewer.SortingFunctions.randomized
1240                    self.main_list_cards = self.sorting_function(self.main_list_cards)
1241                    self.recalculate_main_list_positions()
1242                elif selection == RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_OPTIONS.NAME_DESCENDING_SORTING:
1243                    if self.sorting_function is not RenderableCardListviewer.SortingFunctions.name_descending:
1244                        self.sorting_function = RenderableCardListviewer.SortingFunctions.name_descending
1245                        self.main_list_cards = self.sorting_function(self.main_list_cards)
1246                        self.recalculate_main_list_positions()
1247                elif selection == RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_OPTIONS.NAME_ASCENDING_SORTING:
1248                    if self.sorting_function is not RenderableCardListviewer.SortingFunctions.name_ascending:
1249                        self.sorting_function = RenderableCardListviewer.SortingFunctions.name_ascending
1250                        self.main_list_cards = self.sorting_function(self.main_list_cards)
1251                        self.recalculate_main_list_positions()
1252                elif selection == RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_OPTIONS.AMOUNT_DESCENDING_SORTING:
1253                    if self.sorting_function is not RenderableCardListviewer.SortingFunctions.amount_descending:
1254                        self.sorting_function = RenderableCardListviewer.SortingFunctions.amount_descending
1255                        self.main_list_cards = self.sorting_function(self.main_list_cards)
1256                        self.recalculate_main_list_positions()
1257                elif selection == RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_OPTIONS.AMOUNT_ASCENDING_SORTING:
1258                    if self.sorting_function is not RenderableCardListviewer.SortingFunctions.amount_ascending:
1259                        self.sorting_function = RenderableCardListviewer.SortingFunctions.amount_ascending
1260                        self.main_list_cards = self.sorting_function(self.main_list_cards)
1261                        self.recalculate_main_list_positions()
1262
1263                #display types
1264                elif selection == RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_OPTIONS.SHOW_EACH_CARD_DISPLAY_TYPE:
1265                    if self.main_list_view_state != RenderableCardListviewer.SHOW_EACH_CARD:
1266                        self.main_list_view_state = RenderableCardListviewer.SHOW_EACH_CARD
1267                        self.recalculate_main_list_positions()
1268
1269                elif selection == RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_OPTIONS.SHOW_WITH_AMOUNT_DISPLAY_TYPE:
1270                    if self.main_list_view_state != RenderableCardListviewer.SHOW_WITH_AMOUNT:
1271                        self.main_list_view_state = RenderableCardListviewer.SHOW_WITH_AMOUNT
1272                        self.recalculate_main_list_positions()
1273
1274                #group selection
1275                elif full_trace[:-1] == [RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_OPTIONS.SELECT_GROUP_OPTION_KEY]:
1276
1277                    self.shown_group = selection[0]
1278                    self.reload_current_group()
1279
1280                elif selection == RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_OPTIONS.CREATE_GROUP_OPTION_KEY:
1281                    self.initialize_deck_creation_frame()
1282
1283                self.reload_dropdown_menu_with_progress()
1284
