1319    def bind_events(self):
1320        self.clear_event_callbacks()
1321
1322    def tick(self):
1323        self.manage_pygame_events()
1324
1325        if self.exit_flag_raised():
1326            return None
1327
1328        if self.is_focused():
1329            if self.info_text_active():
1330                self.info_text_tick()
1331
1332            #dropdown events
1333            dropdown_events = self.dropdown_menu.poll_events()
1334
1335            if self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.DROPDOWN_MENU_ACTIVE:
1336                self.dropdown_menu.tick()
1337
1338            for event in dropdown_events:
1339                self.handle_dropdown_menu_selection(event)
1340
1341            #non input accepting states
1342            if self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.MOVING_ONE_ROW_UP:
1343                self.move_one_row_up()
1344            elif self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.MOVING_ONE_ROW_DOWN:
1345                self.move_one_row_down()
1346            elif self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.MOVING_ALL_ROWS_UP:
1347                self.move_all_rows_up()
1348            elif self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.FULL_IMAGE_SHOWN:
1349                if not self.key_pressed(KeyAlternatives.SHOW_IMAGE_KEY):
1350                    self.state = RenderableCardListviewer.MAIN_LIST_FOCUSED
1351            elif self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.DECKNAME_SELECTED_ANIMATION:
1352                self.deckname_selected_animation()
1353            elif self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_BUTTON_SELECTED_ANIMATION:
1354                self.menu_button_selected_animation()
1355            elif self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.INITIALIZE_DECK_RENAMING_FRAME:
1356                self.initialize_deck_renaming_frame()
1357            elif self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.CARD_SNAPBACK_ANIMATION:
1358                self.card_snapback_animation()
1359            elif self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.ENTER_PRESSED:
1360                if not (self.key_pressed(pygame.K_RETURN) or self.key_pressed(KeyAlternatives.ENTER_ALTERNATIVE)):
1361                    if self.prev_state == RenderableCardListviewer.MAIN_LIST_FOCUSED and self.n_cards_shown > 0:
1362                        #if a card was focused, we need to animate putting it back in its original state
1363                        self.state = RenderableCardListviewer.CARD_SNAPBACK_ANIMATION
1364                        self.initialize_card_snapback_animation()
1365                    else:
1366                        self.state = self.prev_state
1367                        if self.enter_clock.elapsed() >= self.time_until_long_enter_pressed:
1368                            self.long_enter_pressed()
1369                        else:
1370                            self.enter_pressed()
1371                        self.key_clock.start()
1372                else:
1373                    if self.prev_state == RenderableCardListviewer.MAIN_LIST_FOCUSED and self.n_cards_shown > 0:
1374                        self.card_pressed_animation()
1375            elif self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.DECK_RENAMING_FRAME_ACTIVE:
1376                ret = self.focused_text_input_subframe.tick()
1377
1378                if ret is None:
1379
1380                    #setting the groupname
1381                    if self.focused_text_input_subframe.exit_with_enter():
1382
1383                        text = self.focused_text_input_subframe.get_input_text()
1384
1385                        if not text or text in list(self.groups.keys()):
1386                            tcolor = (RenderableCardListviewer.INFO_TEXT_ERROR_COLOR if self.info_text_error_color is None else self.info_text_error_color)
1387
1388                            self.print_info_text(
1389                                                    [[(RenderableCardListviewer.DECKNAME_ALREADY_EXISTS_ERROR_INFO_TEXT, tcolor)]],
1390                                                    tcolor,
1391                                                    RenderableCardListviewer.DECKNAME_ALREADY_EXISTS_ERROR_FADING_DURATION
1392                                                )
1393
1394                            self.focused_text_input_subframe.reset_exit_flag()
1395                            self.focused_text_input_subframe.reset_exit_type()
1396
1397                        else:
1398
1399                            data_cp = deepcopy(self.groups[self.shown_group])
1400                            del self.groups[self.shown_group]
1401                            self.shown_group = self.focused_text_input_subframe.get_input_text()
1402                            self.groups[self.shown_group] = data_cp
1403                            self.focused_text_input_subframe = None
1404                            self.focus()
1405                            self.state = RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_DECKNAME_FOCUSED
1406                            self.render_deckname_text()
1407                            self.create_dropdown_menu()
1408
1409                    elif self.focused_text_input_subframe.exit_with_escape():
1410                        self.focused_text_input_subframe = None
1411                        self.state = RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_DECKNAME_FOCUSED
1412
1413                    self.key_clock.start()
1414
1415            elif self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.DECK_CREATION_FRAME_ACTIVE:
1416                ret = self.focused_text_input_subframe.tick()
1417
1418                if ret is None:
1419                    self.finalize_deck_creation_frame()
1420
1421                self.key_clock.start()
1422
1423            else:
1424                #accept inputs
1425
1426                if self.key_clock.elapsed() > self.key_delay:
1427
1428                    if self.key_pressed(pygame.K_ESCAPE):
1429                        self.escape_pressed()
1430                        self.key_clock.start()
1431
1432                    if self.key_pressed(pygame.K_LEFT) or self.key_pressed(KeyAlternatives.LEFT_ALTERNATIVE):
1433                        self.left_pressed()
1434                        self.key_clock.start()
1435
1436                    if self.key_pressed(pygame.K_RIGHT) or self.key_pressed(KeyAlternatives.RIGHT_ALTERNATIVE):
1437                        self.right_pressed()
1438                        self.key_clock.start()
1439
1440                    if self.key_pressed(pygame.K_UP) or self.key_pressed(KeyAlternatives.UP_ALTERNATIVE):
1441                        self.up_pressed()
1442                        self.key_clock.start()
1443
1444                    if self.key_pressed(pygame.K_DOWN) or self.key_pressed(KeyAlternatives.DOWN_ALTERNATIVE):
1445                        self.down_pressed()
1446                        self.key_clock.start()
1447
1448                    if self.key_pressed(KeyAlternatives.SHOW_IMAGE_KEY):
1449                        self.state = RenderableCardListviewer.FULL_IMAGE_SHOWN
1450                        self.prerender_full_image()
1451                        self.key_clock.start()
1452
1453                    if self.key_pressed(pygame.K_RETURN) or self.key_pressed(KeyAlternatives.ENTER_ALTERNATIVE):
1454
1455                        if self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.MAIN_LIST_FOCUSED and self.n_cards_shown > 0:
1456                            self.cards_dict_before_enter = self.main_list_cards_dict[self.selected_card_index]
1457                            self.cards_rects_before_enter = self.main_list_cards_rects[self.cards_dict_before_enter[3]]#the cy
1458                            self.cards_rects_before_enter_index = [i for i in range(len(self.cards_rects_before_enter)) if self.cards_rects_before_enter[i][0] == self.selected_card_index][0]
1459                        self.state = RenderableCardListviewer.ENTER_PRESSED
1460                        self.enter_clock.start()
1461                        self.key_clock.start()
1462
1463                    if self.key_pressed(pygame.K_BACKSPACE) or self.key_pressed(KeyAlternatives.BACK_KEY):
1464                        self.back_pressed()
1465                        self.key_clock.start()
1466
1467        return self
1468    """
1469    INTERACTION FUNCTIONS
1470    """
1471
1472    def left_pressed(self):
1473
1474        if self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.NOTHING_FOCUSED:
1475            self.state = RenderableCardListviewer.MAIN_LIST_FOCUSED
1476            self.selected_card_index = 0
1477        elif self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.MAIN_LIST_FOCUSED:
1478            #if we're at the leftmost state, leave the main list focus
1479            if (self.selected_card_index % self.cards_per_line) == 0:
1480                self.state = RenderableCardListviewer.NOTHING_FOCUSED
1481            else:
1482                self.selected_card_index -= 1
1483        elif self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_BUTTON_FOCUSED:
1484            self.state = RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_DECKSIZE_FOCUSED
1485        elif self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_DECKSIZE_FOCUSED:
1486            self.state = RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_DECKNAME_FOCUSED
1487        elif self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_DECKNAME_FOCUSED:
1488            self.state = RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_BUTTON_FOCUSED
1489        elif self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.DROPDOWN_MENU_ACTIVE:
1490            self.dropdown_menu.move_left()
1491
1492    def right_pressed(self):
1493
1494        if self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.NOTHING_FOCUSED:
1495            self.state = RenderableCardListviewer.MAIN_LIST_FOCUSED
1496            self.selected_card_index = 0
1497        elif self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.MAIN_LIST_FOCUSED:
1498            #if we're at the rightmost state, leave the main list focus
1499            if ((self.selected_card_index + 1) % self.cards_per_line) == 0:
1500                self.state = RenderableCardListviewer.NOTHING_FOCUSED
1501            else:
1502                self.selected_card_index += 1
1503
1504        elif self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_BUTTON_FOCUSED:
1505            self.state = RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_DECKNAME_FOCUSED
1506        elif self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_DECKNAME_FOCUSED:
1507            self.state = RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_DECKSIZE_FOCUSED
1508        elif self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_DECKSIZE_FOCUSED:
1509            self.state = RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_BUTTON_FOCUSED
1510        elif self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.DROPDOWN_MENU_ACTIVE:
1511            self.dropdown_menu.move_right()
1512
1513    def up_pressed(self):
1514
1515        if self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.NOTHING_FOCUSED:
1516            self.state = RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_BUTTON_FOCUSED
1517
1518        elif self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_BUTTON_FOCUSED\
1519            or self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_DECKNAME_FOCUSED\
1520            or self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_DECKSIZE_FOCUSED:
1521
1522            self.state = RenderableCardListviewer.NOTHING_FOCUSED
1523
1524        elif self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.MAIN_LIST_FOCUSED:
1525
1526            if self.n_cards_shown == 0:
1527                self.state = RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_BUTTON_FOCUSED
1528                return
1529
1530            if self.key_pressed(pygame.K_LSHIFT):
1531                if not self.fastscroll_enabled:
1532                    self.fastscroll_enabled = True
1533                    self.rowscroll_copy = self.rowscrolling_duration
1534                    self.rowscrolling_duration = self.fastscroll_duration
1535            elif self.fastscroll_enabled:
1536                self.fastscroll_enabled = False
1537                self.rowscrolling_duration = self.rowscroll_copy
1538            #check for going off, and if the index is in rendered rows
1539            if self.selected_card_index < self.cards_per_line:
1540                self.state = RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_BUTTON_FOCUSED
1541            elif (self.selected_card_index - self.cards_per_line) not in [x[1] for x in self.rendered_rows]:
1542                self.state = RenderableCardListviewer.MOVING_ONE_ROW_UP
1543                self.initialize_move_one_row_up()
1544            else:
1545                self.selected_card_index -= self.cards_per_line
1546
1547        elif self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.DROPDOWN_MENU_ACTIVE:
1548            self.dropdown_menu.move_up()
1549
1550    def down_pressed(self):
1551
1552        if self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.NOTHING_FOCUSED:
1553            self.state = RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_BUTTON_FOCUSED
1554
1555        elif self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_BUTTON_FOCUSED\
1556            or self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_DECKNAME_FOCUSED\
1557            or self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.MENU_DECKSIZE_FOCUSED:
1558
1559            self.state = RenderableCardListviewer.MAIN_LIST_FOCUSED
1560            self.selected_card_index = 0
1561            self.main_list_yscroll = 0
1562
1563        elif self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.MAIN_LIST_FOCUSED:
1564
1565            if self.n_cards_shown == 0:
1566                self.state = RenderableCardListviewer.NOTHING_FOCUSED
1567                return
1568            #check for going off, and if the index is in rendered rows
1569            if self.key_pressed(pygame.K_LSHIFT):
1570                if not self.fastscroll_enabled:
1571                    self.fastscroll_enabled = True
1572                    self.rowscroll_copy = self.rowscrolling_duration
1573                    self.rowscrolling_duration = self.fastscroll_duration
1574            elif self.fastscroll_enabled:
1575                self.fastscroll_enabled = False
1576                self.rowscrolling_duration = self.rowscroll_copy
1577
1578            if self.selected_card_index >= (self.n_cards_shown - self.cards_per_line):
1579                self.selected_card_index += self.cards_per_line
1580                self.selected_card_index %= (self.n_cards_shown)
1581                self.selected_card_index -= (self.cards_per_line - self.n_cards_shown % self.cards_per_line)
1582                if self.selected_card_index < self.cards_per_line:
1583                    self.state = RenderableCardListviewer.MOVING_ALL_ROWS_UP
1584                    self.initialize_move_all_rows_up()
1585            elif len(self.rendered_rows) < (self.cards_per_line * self.cards_per_column):
1586                self.selected_card_index += self.cards_per_line
1587                self.selected_card_index %= self.n_cards_shown
1588            elif (self.selected_card_index + self.cards_per_line) not in [x[1] for x in self.rendered_rows]:
1589
1590                self.state = RenderableCardListviewer.MOVING_ONE_ROW_DOWN
1591                self.initialize_move_one_row_down()
1592            else:
1593                self.selected_card_index += self.cards_per_line
1594
1595        elif self.state == RenderableCardListviewer.DROPDOWN_MENU_ACTIVE:
1596            self.dropdown_menu.move_down()
1597

1874    def card_pressed_animation(self):
1875
1876        percentage = self.enter_clock.elapsed() / self.time_until_long_enter_pressed

1878
1879        self.enter_pressed_on_card_percentage = percentage
1880        #changing the frame dimensions
1881
1882        main_list_index, img_rect, txt_rect, cy = self.cards_dict_before_enter
1883        card_id_index, main_list_cards_index, _1, _2 = self.cards_rects_before_enter[self.cards_rects_before_enter_index]
1884
1885        size_margin = self.card_pressed_size_change_percentage * percentage
1886        img_rect = graphics.apply_margins(img_rect, size_margin, size_margin)
1887        txt_rect = graphics.apply_margins(txt_rect, size_margin, size_margin)
1888
1889        self.main_list_cards_dict[card_id_index] = (main_list_index, img_rect, txt_rect, cy)
1890        self.main_list_cards_rects[cy][self.cards_rects_before_enter_index] = (card_id_index, main_list_cards_index, img_rect, txt_rect)

1899
1900        if percentage >= 1.0:

1902        else:
1903
1904            main_list_index, img_rect, txt_rect, cy = self.cards_dict_before_enter
1905            card_id_index, main_list_cards_index, _1, _2 = self.cards_rects_before_enter[self.cards_rects_before_enter_index]
1906
1907            size_margin = (self.enter_pressed_on_card_percentage * self.card_pressed_size_change_percentage) * (1.0 - percentage)
1908            img_rect = graphics.apply_margins(img_rect, size_margin, size_margin)
1909            txt_rect = graphics.apply_margins(txt_rect, size_margin, size_margin)
1910
1911            self.main_list_cards_dict[card_id_index] = (main_list_index, img_rect, txt_rect, cy)
1912            self.main_list_cards_rects[cy][self.cards_rects_before_enter_index] = (card_id_index, main_list_cards_index, img_rect, txt_rect)
1913

1915    def finalize_card_snapback_animation(self):
1916
1917        main_list_index, img_rect, txt_rect, cy = self.cards_dict_before_enter
1918        card_id_index, main_list_cards_index, _1, _2 = self.cards_rects_before_enter[self.cards_rects_before_enter_index]
1919

1922
1923        self.state = RenderableCardListviewer.MAIN_LIST_FOCUSED
1924
1925        if fequal(self.enter_pressed_on_card_percentage, 1.0):
1926            self.long_enter_pressed()
1927        else:
1928            self.enter_pressed()

678    def rerender(self):
679        #info text calc
680        iheight = int(self.height * self.info_text_vlen_p)
681        self.info_text_frame = pygame.Rect( 0,
682                                            self.height - iheight,
683                                            int(self.width * self.info_text_hlen_p),
684                                            iheight
685                                            )
686        self.info_text_surface = pygame.Surface((self.info_text_frame.width, self.info_text_frame.height), pygame.SRCALPHA)
687        self.info_text_rendered = None
688        #resetting card index
689        self.selected_card_index = 0
690        #creating the full image surface
691        self.full_image_surface = pygame.Surface((self.width, self.height), pygame.SRCALPHA)
692        #getting border width and height
693        self.border_width = int(self.border_frame_margin * self.width)
694        self.border_height = int(self.border_frame_margin * self.height)
695        #the inner area is the frame inside without the border
696        self.inner_area = pygame.Rect(self.x + self.border_width, self.y + self.border_height,
697                                        self.width - 2*self.border_width, self.height - 2*self.border_height)
698        #creating the own surface
699        self.surface = pygame.Surface((self.width, self.height), pygame.SRCALPHA)
700        #calculating actual border outline sizes
701        self.border_outline_width = int(self.border_width * self.border_frame_outline_margin)
702        self.border_outline_height = int(self.border_height * self.border_frame_outline_margin)
703        #selecting
704        self.used_border_outline_size = min(self.border_outline_width, self.border_outline_height)
705        #the inner border corners
706        self.inner_border_corners = [
707                                    (self.border_width-self.used_border_outline_size, self.border_height - self.used_border_outline_size),
708                                    (self.width - self.border_width, self.border_height - self.used_border_outline_size),
709                                    (self.width - self.border_width, self.height - self.border_height + self.used_border_outline_size),
710                                    (self.border_width - self.used_border_outline_size, self.height - self.border_height)
711                                    ]
712        #(rect, color)
713        self.border_lines = [
714                                (pygame.Rect(0, 0, self.width, self.border_height), self.border_frame_color),
715                                (pygame.Rect(self.width - self.border_width, 0, self.border_width, self.height), self.border_frame_color),
716                                (pygame.Rect(0, 0, self.border_width, self.height), self.border_frame_color),
717                                (pygame.Rect(0, self.height - self.border_height, self.width, self.border_height), self.border_frame_color),
718
719                                #outer outline
720                                (pygame.Rect(0, 0, self.width, self.border_outline_height), self.border_frame_outline_color),
721                                (pygame.Rect(self.width - self.border_outline_width, 0, self.border_outline_width, self.height), self.border_frame_outline_color),
722                                (pygame.Rect(0, 0, self.border_outline_width, self.height), self.border_frame_outline_color),
723                                (pygame.Rect(0, self.height - self.border_outline_height, self.width, self.border_outline_height), self.border_frame_outline_color)
724
725                                #inner outline will be calculated
726                            ]
727
728        #helper function, connects the inner border corners
729        def rs(p1, p2):
730
731            x = p1[0]
732            y = p1[1]
733
734            w = p2[0] - p1[0]
735            if w == 0:
736                w = self.used_border_outline_size
737
738            h = p2[1] - p1[1]
739            if h == 0:
740                h = self.used_border_outline_size
741
742            if w < 0 or h < 0:
743
744                x = p2[0]
745                y = p2[1]
746
747                w = p1[0] - p2[0]
748                if w == 0:
749                    w = self.used_border_outline_size
750
751                h = p1[1] - p2[1]
752                if h == 0:
753                    h = self.used_border_outline_size
754
755
756            return pygame.Rect(x, y, w, h)
757
758        for i in range(len(self.inner_border_corners)+1):
759
760            i1 = i % len(self.inner_border_corners)
761            i2 = (i+1) % len(self.inner_border_corners)
762
763            p1, p2 = self.inner_border_corners[i1], self.inner_border_corners[i2]
764
765            self.border_lines.append((rs(p1, p2), self.border_frame_outline_color))
766
767        #rendering the Name Label
768        self.menu_label_height = int(self.inner_area.height * self.menu_label_vmargin)
769        self.menu_label_surface = pygame.Surface((self.inner_area.width, self.menu_label_height), pygame.SRCALPHA)
770        self.menu_label_highlighted_surface = self.menu_label_surface.copy()
771        self.menu_label_highlighted_surface.fill((*self.menu_label_highlighted_color, self.menu_label_highlighted_alpha))
772        self.menu_label_surface_pos = (self.inner_area.x, self.inner_area.y)
773        #calculating menu label dimensions
774        self.menu_label_frame = self.inner_area.copy()
775        self.menu_label_frame.height = self.menu_label_height
776        #inner menu label is the label after applying the margins
777        self.inner_menu_label_frame = self.menu_label_frame.copy()
778        self.inner_menu_label_frame = graphics.apply_margins(self.inner_menu_label_frame, self.menu_label_inner_hmargin, self.menu_label_inner_vmargin)
779
780
781        """
782        -----------------------------------------
783        MENU LABEL WIDGETS
784        -----------------------------------------
785        """
786
787        #now calculating the menu options
788        self.menu_button_frame, self.deckname_frame, self.decksize_frame = graphics.split_rect_horizontally(
789                                                                                                        pygame.Rect(
790                                                                                                        self.inner_menu_label_frame.x - self.menu_label_frame.x,
791                                                                                                        self.inner_menu_label_frame.y - self.menu_label_frame.y,
792                                                                                                        self.inner_menu_label_frame.width, self.inner_menu_label_frame.height),
793                                                                                                        [self.menu_label_menu_button_hmargin,
794                                                                                                        1.0-(self.menu_label_menu_button_hmargin + self.menu_label_decksize_text_hmargin),
795                                                                                                        self.menu_label_decksize_text_hmargin
796                                                                                                        ]
797                                                                                                        )
798        #now rendering the menu items
799        #rendering the menu button
800        self.menu_button_unfocused_image_rendered,\
